task: Prepare a Loaded Burrito: tortilla, cooked rice, cooked steak, chopped tomato, and chopped lettuce, plated in this order.
timingNote: Recorded text interaction. Synthetic voices added for presentation; playback is time-expanded. Tick stamps preserve the original sequence.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Give me a shout the moment the rice is done, will you?

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Will do. The rice has just started cooking; I’ll watch for it to finish.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: The rice is done! When you collect it, make sure the raw tortilla goes onto the plate first, then scoop the rice.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: How many cutting boards are free right now?

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Two cutting boards are free—the two on the lower central counter. The board below the rice pot still holds your chopped steak.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: The rice has been sitting ready for a while. After loading and turning on the steak pan, get a plate, scoop the raw tortilla first, then collect the rice promptly.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: The rice has been left on the heat until it’s smoking. Scoop it now, then collect the steak from the central-right pan.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: The steak has been left on the heat until it’s smoking. Scoop it from the central-right pan now.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Got the steak on the plate.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: What did I add right after the tortilla, and is it done?

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: You added rice right after the tortilla. Yes—it was fully cooked when you scooped it onto the plate.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: You’ve picked up another lettuce, but yours is already chopped on the right-hand board of the lower central counter. Put the extra raw lettuce on an empty counter, retrieve your plate from the bottom counter beside the steak crate, and scoop the chopped lettuce. Then serve.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Ah, totally forgot I already chopped some lettuce.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Your hands are empty now, so you can leave that extra lettuce on the board and retrieve your plate. Use the already chopped lettuce on the lower central right-hand board.

actions.text: go to the empty cutting board
